Three numeric columns (num_feature_04, num_feature_08, num_feature_12) share an identical max of 9999.0 while their means sit around 127-131 and their stds are inflated to ~825-846, versus ~12 for every other numeric feature — a clear sentinel/missing-value encoding that would badly distort scaling and any distance- or gradient-based model. Missingness is widespread: ~1.4-8.6% across numeric columns and 2.7-22.1% across categoricals, with cat_feature_04 through cat_feature_07 exceeding the 10% warning threshold (12.7%, 13.9%, 19.5%, 22.1%). Outlier counts by IQR and z-score are modest relative to 1200 rows. Positives: no zero-inflation, the target is a clean binary with a ~69/31 split, and is_active/signup_date are complete. Recommended path: recode the 9999 sentinels to NaN and impute (median for numeric, explicit 'missing' level or most-frequent for categorical), then re-profile before training.

The dataset (1200 rows x 24 cols, binary target with 68.9%/31.1% class balance) is not ready to train as-is; it needs cleaning first, though the issues look tractable rather than fatal.

Main blockers:
1) Sentinel values / broken scale. num_feature_04, num_feature_08 and num_feature_12 each have max = 9999.0 while their q50 sits near 55-62 (e.g. num_feature_04 mean 126.69 vs std 846.24). This is an obvious sentinel-coded anomaly that inflates variance ~70x; these must be recoded as missing (or clipped) before scaling.
2) Missingness across the board. Every numeric feature has missing values, ranging from num_feature_05 (0.0) up to num_feature_14 (missing_pct 0.08583333333333333) and num_feature_04 (0.085). Categoricals are worse: cat_feature_04 (0.1267), cat_feature_05 (0.1392), cat_feature_06 (0.195) and cat_feature_07 (0.2208) all exceed 10%. Imputation (median/mode or a model-based scheme) plus missing-indicator flags is warranted, and the high-cardinality categoricals (cat_feature_07 cardinality 31, cat_feature_06 27) need encoding decisions.
3) Outliers beyond the sentinels: IQR counts range up to 15 (num_feature_03, num_feature_08, num_feature_12) and z-score counts up to 8 (num_feature_04, num_feature_08, num_feature_12)-again concentrated in the sentinel columns, so most of this should resolve once 9999 is treated as missing.

No duplicate/ID leakage or label issues are evident, is_active and signup_date are complete, and target is clean with 2 classes. So the path is: treat the 9999 sentinels as missing, impute numerics (median) and categoricals (mode/unknown), encode/drop high-cardinality categoricals, then re-check distributions before training. Recommended checks: confirm 9999 sentinel semantics, decide imputation strategy for the 10-50% missing columns, handle categorical cardinality, and re-profile after cleaning to verify outlier counts drop.
